_comment: Control panel for the PMD Java gate. Hook: ~/.claude/hooks/pmd-java-gate.py
_off_switch: Set enabled to false to kill the gate instantly, no other change needed.
_scope: changed-lines = only flag lines this edit touched, legacy debt stays quiet. whole-file = flag everything in the file.
_advisory_rules: These report but never block. Everything else blocks and is fed back to the agent to self-correct.
_timeout: Hook gives up silently past this. Measured cost is ~1s per edit.
_ruleset: Rules live in personal config (skills/java-quality/klever-java-rules.xml) and apply to every Java file. ruleset_path is only a REPO OVERRIDE: if a repo contains that file, the team ratified its own rules and they win.
_checkstyle: Checkstyle runs alongside PMD and only carries checks PMD cannot do (unused imports, naming, fall-through, equals/hashCode). Deliberately no Javadoc* checks: stock configs REQUIRE javadoc, which is the opposite of the standard here. Set checkstyle_binary to "" to disable it alone.
